title: INVITE THE HOLY SPIRIT TO LEAD YOUR WEEK
text: Glory to God. Glory to God. Glory to God. Somebody shout hallelujah. I want you to understand that what we are about to do in the next few moments is not just a teaching. It is an invitation into a lifestyle. It is an invitation into a dimension of living where your week is not controlled by circumstances. Your week is not controlled by what happened yesterday. Your weak is not controlled by economic projections or political instabilities. Your weak is controlled by the supremacy of the Holy Spirit who is the governor of the affairs of men. I need you to open your spirit right now because we are not playing church. We are engaging mysteries that will determine whether your week will be predictable or supernatural. You see, the difference between ordinary believers and believers who walk in consistent victory is not their level of faith alone. It is their understanding of how to engage the Holy Spirit as the leader, as the director, as the one who orchestrates their daily affairs. Can I tell you something that will change your life? The Holy Spirit is not just the helper that you call when you are in trouble. He's the leader that you engage before trouble even comes. He's the one who shows you things to come. Jesus said in John 16:13, "How beat! When he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth, for he shall not speak of himself, but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak, and he will show you things to come." Do you know what that scripture is saying? It is saying that the Holy Spirit has access to information about your future. He sees Monday before Monday comes. He sees that meeting before you get to that meeting. He sees that conversation before it happens. And if you will honor him, if you will invite him, if you will make him the president of your weekly affairs, he will guide you with precision that will shock you. I want to prophesy to somebody here. The season of struggling blindly is over. The season of moving without direction is terminated in Jesus name. From today you are entering into a dimension where your steps are ordered, where you move with prophetic precision, where you avoid satanic traps because the Holy Spirit shows you the way to go. Listen to me carefully. When you wake up on Monday morning, the battle is not just about going to work or doing business. The battle is about whose intelligence will govern your movements. Will it be your human wisdom alone? Will it be what people told you? Or will it be the intelligence of the Holy Spirit who knows all things? who sees all things and who has the capacity to lead you into perfect alignment with the will of God. I remember the scripture in Proverbs 3:5 and 6, trust in the Lord with all thine heart and lean not onto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him and he shall direct thy paths. That word acknowledge in the Hebrew carries the weight of intimate knowledge of making him the central reference point in every decision. It means before you make that phone call, you check with him. Before you send that message, you inquire from him. Before you commit to that transaction, you seek his counsel. You see, many believers are living frustrated lives. Not because God has abandoned them, but because they have abandoned the leadership of the Holy Spirit. They wake up in the morning, they say their morning prayers, which is good. But after that prayer, they switch to autopilot. They move based on human logic. They move based on what worked last year. They move based on trends and projections. And before they know it, they are caught in situations that prayer alone cannot deliver them from because they stepped into those situations without divine permission. Can I prophesy? There are some of you watching me right now. There are conflicts you got into this past week that you should never have been involved in. There are conversations you had that you should never have entertained. There are decisions you made that the Holy Spirit was warning you about, but you were too busy to pay attention. But today, God is giving you another opportunity. He's saying, "Come back to me. Make me the leader of your weak. Let me show you what to do and what not to do." The book of Isaiah 30:21 says, "And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, this is the way. Walk ye in it. When ye turn to the right hand and when ye turn to the left, this is the promise of divine guidance. This is what happens when the Holy Spirit becomes your leader. He speaks to you in real time. He tells you which door to enter. He tells you which opportunity to seize. He tells you which battle to fight and which battle to ignore. Now, let me teach you something profound. The Holy Spirit does not force his leadership upon you. He's a gentleman. He waits to be invited. He waits to be consulted. Many believers have the Holy Spirit living in them, but they are not benefiting from his leadership because they have never consciously, deliberately, intentionally invited him to take charge of their weekly activities. You know what you need to do beginning from tonight before this week starts because in the spirit Monday has already been framed. You need to have what I call a leadership transfer ceremony. You need to tell the Holy Spirit. Holy Spirit, I acknowledge that I don't know what I'm going to face this week. I don't know who I'm going to meet. I don't know what opportunities will come. I don't know what attacks the enemy has planned. But I invite you to take the leadership position in my life this week. Be my guide. Be my counselor. Be my strategic advisor. Show me what to do. Show me where to go. Show me what to say and what not to say. When you do this, something shifts in the realm of the spirit. Angels are assigned. Demonic conspiracies are exposed. Divine opportunities are opened. You begin to move with a grace that makes people wonder, "How did you know?" And you will just smile because you know it was the Holy Spirit. Let me tell you what happened in the book of Acts chapter 8. There was a man called Philillip who was having a successful revival in Samaria. People were getting healed, delivered, and saved. But in the middle of that success, the Holy Spirit spoke to him and said, "Arise and go toward the south, unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza, which is desert." Now, logically that instruction made no sense. Leave a successful crusade to go to a desert. But Philip obeyed. And when he got there, he met one man, the Ethiopian uno, a man who was strategically positioned to take the gospel to an entire nation. Do you see the wisdom of the Holy Spirit? If Philip had been moving by his own logic, he would have said, "No, let me stay here where the crowds are." But because he was led by the spirit, he was positioned for an assignment that changed the course of history for an entire nation. That is what happens when you let the Holy Spirit lead your week. He will position you where you need to be even when it doesn't make sense to your natural mind. I need somebody to make this declaration with me right now. Say, "Holy Spirit, I surrender the leadership of my week to you. Guide me, lead me, show me where to go and where not to go. Open doors that no man can shut and shut doors that will lead me into trouble. I trust your intelligence more than I trust my own understanding. Lead me in the path of righteousness for your name's sake." Now let me tell you the protocol of engaging the Holy Spirit as your weekly leader. First you must cultivate sensitivity. The Holy Spirit speaks but he speaks in whispers most of the time. He speaks through that still small voice. He speaks through impressions. He speaks through peace or the absence of peace. He speaks through the word of God. He speaks through dreams and visions. But if your spirit is too busy, too cluttered with noise, too distracted by social media and entertainment, you will miss his leading. Romans 8:14 says, "For as many as are led by the spirit of God, they are the sons of God." Being led is not passive. It requires attention. It requires focus. It requires spiritual sensitivity. You need to create times during your week where you just sit quietly before God and say, "Holy Spirit, what do you want to tell me? What do you want to show me? Is there anything I need to know about this week? And I tell you, the Holy Spirit is faithful. He will download wisdom into your spirit. He will show you things you need to prepare for. He will warn you about traps. He will show you opportunities that are coming. But you must create the atmosphere for him to speak. Let me give you another key. Obedience. The Holy Spirit will not continue to lead someone who keeps ignoring his instructions. If he tells you to call someone and you don't do it, if he tells you to sew a seed and you hold back, if he tells you to avoid a certain place and you go there anyway, you are training yourself to become dull to his voice. But when you obey promptly, when you act on his instructions, even when they don't make sense, you are sharpening your sensitivity and he will speak to you more clearly. I remember when God told me to give away something that I really valued. In my mind, I was trying to negotiate with God, but the Holy Spirit kept pressing. And when I finally obeyed, within two weeks, God opened a door for me that brought me resources a 100 times greater than what I gave away. That is the reward of obeying the spirit's leading. He knows what he's doing. He sees the bigger picture. Now, here is something else you must understand. When you invite the Holy Spirit to lead your week, you are also inviting him to disrupt your plans. Yes, you heard me right. Because sometimes what you planned for your week is not what God wants for your week. Sometimes your plan would have taken you into danger. Sometimes your plan would have made you miss a divine appointment. Sometimes your plan is good, but God's plan is better. So you need to hold your weekly schedule with an open hand and say, "Holy Spirit, if there is anything in my plan that is not aligned with your will, please disrupt it, cancel it, redirect me. I would rather follow your plan and succeed than follow my plan and struggle." Proverbs 16:9 says, "A man's heart deiseth his way, but the Lord directed his steps." We make our plans, but God orders our steps. And when you invite the Holy Spirit to lead, he will make adjustments to your plans that will save you from heartache and position you for blessing. Let me prophesy to somebody. There is a trip you planned for this week and the enemy wanted to use that trip to bring you into trouble. But because you are praying this prayer tonight, the Holy Spirit is going to frustrate that trip. Something will happen that will make you cancel it or reschedu it and later you will find out that you escaped a major trap. Give God praise right now. Listen to me. When the Holy Spirit leads you weak, he doesn't just lead you to good places. He leads you away from dangerous places. He doesn't just show you what to do. He shows you what not to do. He doesn't just open doors. He closes doors that would have destroyed you. That is the advantage of having the Holy Spirit as your leader. Now, let me teach you how to maintain the leadership of the Holy Spirit throughout the week. You see, it's not just about praying on Sunday night and then forgetting about him till next Sunday. No, you need to keep checking in with him every day, multiple times a day. Before that meeting, pause and say, "Holy Spirit, give me wisdom for this meeting." Before you make that decision, pause and say, "Holy Spirit, is this the right decision?" Before you respond to that email, pause and say, "Holy Spirit, what should I say?" This is what the Bible calls praying without ceasing in 1 Thessalonians 5:17. It doesn't mean you're on your knees 24 hours a day. It means you are in constant communion with the Holy Spirit, constantly checking in with him, constantly seeking his input, constantly acknowledging his presence. And when you live like this, do you know what happens? You begin to avoid mistakes that other people are making. You begin to seize opportunities that other people are missing. You begin to walk with a confidence that is not based on your ability but on the assurance that you are being led by someone who knows all things. Can I tell you about a man in the Bible who understood this principle? His name was Joseph. When he was in Portifer's house, the Bible says the Lord was with Joseph and he was a prosperous man. It didn't say Joseph was a talented man even though he was talented. It said the Lord was with him. And because the Lord was with him, whatever he did prospered. Later when he was in prison, prison, the Bible says the Lord was with Joseph. And even in prison, he found favor. Even in prison, he was promoted. Even in prison, he was positioned for his destiny. Why? Because he understood how to keep God involved in his daily affairs. When you make the Holy Spirit the leader of your weak, it doesn't matter where you are or what situation you find yourself in. You will prosper, you will succeed, you will overcome. Because success is not about your location. It's about who is leading you. Somebody needs to hear this. Stop complaining about where you are and start inviting the Holy Spirit to lead you where you are. He will turn your prison into a palace. He will turn your desert into a garden. He will turn your valley into a mountain. All you need is his leadership. Now, let me address something that might be bothering some of you. You might be saying, "But pastor, I'm not hearing the Holy Spirit clearly. I'm not sure if he's him speaking or just my own thoughts." Let me help you. The Holy Spirit's voice is consistent with the word of God. He will never tell you to do something that contradicts scripture. The Holy Spirit's voice brings peace. Even when he corrects you, there is a peace that comes with it. The Holy Spirit's voice produces fruit. When you obey him, you see good results. The Holy Spirit's voice is persistent. If it's really him, he will keep bringing it back to your heart until you obey. So, you need to test the impressions you receive. You need to line them up with scripture. You need to check if they produce peace and you need to be patient because sometimes the Holy Spirit is training you to discern his voice and that takes time. But don't use the excuse of I'm not sure to keep living without his guidance. Start somewhere. Start by simply asking him every morning, Holy Spirit, what do you want me to know today? And then pay attention. Pay attention to the scriptures that come alive to you. Pay attention to the thoughts that drop in your heart. Pay attention to the peace or discomfort you feel about certain decisions. That is the Holy Spirit speaking to you. Let me give you a powerful testimony. There was a time I was supposed to attend a particular event. Everything was arranged. But on the morning of that day, I felt this unusual discomfort in my spirit. I couldn't explain it. Everything looked fine naturally. But in my spirit, I felt don't go. I struggled with it because I had already committed. But I obeyed the Holy Spirit and I canceled. Later I found out that there was a major crisis at that event that would have affected my reputation if I had been there. That is the power of being led by the spirit. He protects you from things you don't even know about. Now as we move towards prayer, I want you to understand something critical. The Holy Spirit is not just interested in leading your professional life or your business. He wants to lead your relationships. He wants to lead your finances. He wants to lead your health decisions. He wants to lead your ministry. He wants to lead every single area of your life. How many of you have made relationship mistakes because you didn't consult the Holy Spirit? How many of you have made financial mistakes because you didn't seek his wisdom? How many of you have damaged your health because you ignored the prompings of the spirit? Today is the day to change that pattern. Today is the day to make him lord over everything. The Bible says in Colossians 3:15, "And let the peace of God rule in your hearts." That word rule there means to act as an umpire to make the final decision. So when you are not sure about a decision, check your peace. If the Holy Spirit is not giving you peace about it, don't do it. Even if it looks good, even if people are encouraging you, if there is no peace, don't move. But if he gives you peace, move with confidence. Even if people don't understand. Now I'm going to lead you in a prayer and I want you to pray with everything in you. This is not a casual prayer. This is a prayer of consecration. This is a prayer of invitation. This is a prayer that will shift the atmosphere over your week and position you for supernatural guidance. But before we pray, let me prophesy over your life. From this week forward, you will not miss divine appointments. From this week forward, you will not fall into traps that were set for you. From this week forward, you will walk with unusual wisdom that will make people ask you, "How did you know?" From this week forward, the leadership of the Holy Spirit will become tangible in your daily life. Doors that were closed will open. Connections that were delayed will manifest. Opportunities that you thought were gone will resurface. Because when the Holy Spirit leads, he doesn't just lead you. He prepares the path before you. Now, I want you to lift up your hands wherever you are. And if you are in a place where you can speak out loud, begin to pray with me. If you can't speak out loud, pray in your heart, but pray with intensity. Holy Spirit, I honor you. I worship you. I acknowledge you as the third person of the Trinity, co-equal with the Father and the Son. I recognize that you are not just a force or an influence. You are a person and you desire relationship with me. Forgive me for the times I have ignored your voice. Forgive me for the times I move without consulting you. Forgive me for the times I grieved you with my disobedience. Today I repent and I return to you as my leader. Holy Spirit, I invite you to take absolute control of my week. I surrender Monday to you. I surrender Tuesday to you. I surrender Wednesday to you. I surrender Thursday to you. I surrender Friday to you. I surrender Saturday to you. I surrender Sunday to you. Every day of this week belongs to you. Lead me, guide me, direct me, show me where to go and where not to go. Holy Spirit, sharpen my spiritual sensitivity. Train my ears to hear your voice clearly. Train my heart to discern your prompings. Remove every distraction that would make me miss your leading. Remove every noise that would drown out your whisper. Make me so sensitive to you that I can discern your slightest nudge. I declare that this week I will not make any major decision without consulting you. I will not enter into any agreement without your approval. I will not commit my resources without your direction. You are my counselor and I depend on your wisdom. Holy Spirit, I ask you to frustrate every plan of the enemy against my life this week. Every trap that has been set, let it backfire. Every ambush that has been arranged, let it be exposed. Every conspiracy against my progress, let it scatter in Jesus' name. Lead me on paths of safety. Lead me on paths of peace. lead me on paths of prosperity. I decree that this week I will be at the right place at the right time. I will meet the right people. I will receive the right information. I will make the right decisions because the Holy Spirit is leading me. I cannot miss my way because the Holy Spirit is guiding me. I cannot fall into error. Holy Spirit download into my spirit everything I need to know about this week. If there is anything I need to prepare for, show me now. If there is any danger I need to avoid, warn me now. If there is any opportunity I need to position myself for, reveal it to me now. I am listening. I am paying attention. Speak to me. I declare that my ears are open to your voice. My heart is sensitive to your prompings. My spirit is aligned with your will. I will not be stubborn. I will not be rebellious. When you speak, I will obey. When you warn, I will heed. When you direct, I will move. And I thank you, Holy Spirit, because you are faithful. You have promised to lead me and you will do it. You have promised to guide me and you will not fail. You have promised to show me things to come and your word is true. I trust you. I depend on you. I lean on you. Now, Holy Spirit, release your angels to work on my behalf this week. Let them go before me and prepare the way. Let them stand guard over me and protect me from evil. Let them war on my behalf and give me victory in every battle. I decree that because I am led by the spirit of God, I am a child of God and heaven backs me up in the mighty name of Jesus, I have prayed. Amen. Now, receive the impartation of prophetic sensitivity. Receive the grace to hear the Holy Spirit clearly. Receive the anointing to obey promptly. Receive the wisdom to move with precision. This week will be different. This week will be supernatural. This week will be glorious because the Holy Spirit is leading you. Give God a shout of praise. Hallelujah. Glory to God. Now go into your week with confidence. You are not moving alone. The Holy Spirit is with you. He's in you. He's leading you. And that makes all the difference. God bless you. Now, as we seal this prayer, I want you to understand something that will change how you approach this entire week. The Holy Spirit is not intimidated by your schedule. He's not confused by your complexity. He is not overwhelmed by the magnitude of what you are facing. He knows the end from the beginning. And he has already mapped out your path of victory. I speak to your Monday morning right now. That meeting that has been making you anxious, the Holy Spirit will give you the exact words to speak. That project that seems impossible, the Holy Spirit will download strategies and ideas that will cause breakthrough. That conversation you've been dreading, the Holy Spirit will give you grace and favor that will turn that situation completely around. Monday is covered by the blood of Jesus. Monday is soaked in the anointing. Monday will not break you. Monday will bless you. I speak to your Tuesday. Every challenge that rises up, you will overcome it. Every obstacle that presents itself, you will surmount it. The Holy Spirit will cause doors to open that human effort could not open, he will cause people to remember you who had forgotten about you. He will cause resources to locate you from unexpected sources. Tuesday is your day of supernatural turnaround. I speak to the middle of your week. Wednesday and Thursday. I break the back of midweek fatigue in Jesus' name. I break the spirit of discouragement that attacks people when they feel like they're not making progress. The Holy Spirit will renew your strength. He will refresh your vision. He will rekindle your passion. You will not faint. You will not grow weary. You will mount up with wings like eagles. You will run and not be tired. You will walk and not collapse. I speak to your Friday. Every seed you have swn this week, I command it to produce a harvest before the week ends. Every effort you have made, I decree that you will see the fruit of your labor. The Holy Spirit will crown your week with testimonies. He will crown your week with breakthroughs. He will crown your week with answered prayers. Friday will not just be the end of your work week. It will be the manifestation of God's faithfulness in your life. And I speak to your weekend, Saturday and Sunday. Let them be days of rest, refreshing, and divine encounters. Let the Holy Spirit minister to you in ways that will prepare you for the next season. Let him heal what needs to be healed. Let him restore what needs to be restored. Let him speak to you concerning the things that are ahead. Now, one more thing before we close. I decree that the favor of God will speak for you this week in places where your mouth cannot reach. The mercy of God will cover you in situations where you made mistakes. The power of God will back you up when you face opposition. And the presence of God will comfort you when things don't go as planned. You are not ordinary. You are spiritled. You are heavenbacked. You are divinely guided. This week belongs to you in Jesus's mighty name. Now go forth and walk in victory.
